text:
A separate table logging comments the bot has seen or notified about was considered while designing the [delayed] reply deferral, and rejected.

The goal behind it was to make pending_comments safe to delete. The 60-minute expiry already gives that property: dropping the table loses at most the last hour of delayed replies, and nothing else depends on it. A log table that no code reads would be dead weight.

It is also not needed to prevent duplicate notifications. The monotonic current_item pointer already guarantees each item is scanned once.
